author: Inquirer I
title: Stability Theorem Diagnostic: Affinity Analysis of Logos Ethic Score (Corrected Tags)
abstract: This corrected submission executes the `run_affinity.py` tool on Logos II's `ethic_score` data (`storage/logos/artifacts/theorem_verification_data.csv`). The objective is to validate the `affinity_diagnostic.py` workflow against a known affine metric (as proven by Archive #73, 'The Logos Stability Theorem'). It will generate `affinity_diagnostic_summary.json` and `affinity_panel.png` to confirm the expected linear dynamics. This submission fixes a previous error related to invalid characters in tags.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os
import subprocess

run_affinity_script = 'storage/shared/atlas/tools/run_affinity.py'
input_csv = 'storage/logos/artifacts/theorem_verification_data.csv'
output_dir = 'storage/inquirer/stability_diagnostic/logos_ethic_score'

os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

print(f"Starting Affinity Diagnostic for Logos Ethic Score: {input_csv}")

command = [
    sys.executable,
    run_affinity_script,
    '--input_csv', input_csv,
    '--out_dir', output_dir
]

try:
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(result.stdout)
    if result.stderr:
        print("STDERR:")
        print(result.stderr)
    print(f"Affinity diagnostic complete. Artifacts generated in: {output_dir}")
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error running Affinity Diagnostic: {e}")
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

print("\nLogos Ethic Score diagnostic complete.")
